major_work.title: News Cluster Independence / Reprint Inflation Audit
major_work.hypothesis: Raw article-count/state escalation can overstate evidence strength when heterogeneous or reprinted stories are merged into one issue cluster.
findings: GN-e58373ffb2d189f6 is headed by the BOK 2026 H1 domestic payment-settlement release, but its stored articles include unrelated KOSPI close/foreign-selling stories.
76 of 82 articles are marked reprints; only 6 independent sources are recorded. Article-count growth therefore must not be interpreted as 82 independent confirmations.
The issue state is STRENGTHENING, but this state is contaminated by heterogeneous membership and reprint concentration. No market-effect probability is estimable from this packet.
The latest KRX close remains frozen while global fields continue updating; same-row cross-market values remain unsuitable for contemporaneous event attribution without session alignment.
contamination: post-move KOSPI close stories mixed with official BOK release
published/observed/actionable clocks not normalized for causal event study
single contaminated issue cluster is not a population-level estimate
next_validation: Recluster GN-e58373ffb2d189f6, then recompute independent-source count and state transition.
Compare naive article-count importance against independent-source-weighted and semantic-purity-weighted challengers on historical PIT issues.
For AI-A PCE hypothesis, require PIT 2y/10y/30y yield observations plus next eligible KRX session semiconductor basket/foreign-flow packet before event-study probability.
